name: Namaz Akışı: Prayer Times
subtitle: Ad-free reminders and Qibla
promotionalText: Reminds you so you don't miss prayer time, and grows more insistent as the time runs short. Free, ad-free, offline and in 78 languages. Your data stays on your phone.
description:
When the day is a rush, it is easy to miss that a prayer time has begun, or to hear the adhan, think “I'll pray in a minute” and then forget. It happens to most of us. Namaz Akışı was made for these moments. It tells you when a prayer time begins, calls you more insistently as the time runs short, and helps you fit prayer into your day. It is completely free, has no ads and works without the internet.

IF YOU'VE GROWN USED TO NOTIFICATIONS
A single notification is easy to swipe away. Prayer Guardian sets 1 to 6 reminders for each prayer time. As the time runs short, the reminders come more often and their tone grows firmer. On iOS 26 and later, a real alarm rings at the step you choose. You can pick the reminder sound from the app's sounds or add your own sound file. Once you say “I've prayed”, the reminders for that prayer go quiet.

IF YOUR DAY IS BUSY
If a meeting in your calendar falls at the end of a prayer time, the app reminds you to pray before the meeting. For Jumu'ah and for the prayers you want to pray at the mosque, it lets you know ahead of time, as early as your walk to the mosque takes. If you haven't prayed Isha, it reminds you before your bedtime.

NO RINGING PHONE AT THE MOSQUE
The Prayer Focus, which you set up once with Shortcuts, silences your iPhone when you arrive at the mosque and brings it back to how it was when you leave.

ON THE ROAD AND ABROAD
Prayer times are calculated from the coordinates of where you are, following the timetable the mosques of that country use. In Türkiye, the Diyanet method is used. When you go to another country, the app suggests the local timetable, and the method never changes without your approval. You find the Qibla with the compass or the camera view. None of this needs the internet.

IF YOUR QADA DEBT FEELS DAUNTING
A wizard calculates your qada debt. When you pray an obligatory prayer, the app suggests praying one qada alongside it, and with one tap you deduct it from your Qada log. If you like, missed obligatory prayers are added to the log automatically when the prayer day ends.

IF BUILDING A ROUTINE IS HARD
Every day you pray in full adds one day to your streak. If a long streak breaks for a day, you win it back by praying in full for two days, so one off day doesn't wipe out your effort. The Progress screen shows a daily, weekly and monthly breakdown.

START THE DAY WITH A VERSE
A verse with its translation, renewed at every Fajr, sits in a widget on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

IN YOUR OWN LANGUAGE
The app is available in 78 languages. Screens and notifications work in the language you choose. In languages such as Arabic, Urdu and Persian, the interface runs from right to left.

APPLE WATCH AND iPAD
• On Apple Watch, you see the time left, say “I've prayed” from your wrist, find the Qibla and do your tasbih. The Fajr alarm can simply vibrate your wrist.
• A wide layout on iPad. Your phone and tablet pass your “I've prayed” to each other over your home network.
• Send your location to the Android TV at home with a QR code, and see prayer times on the big screen.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
You don't need an account. The app has no ads, tracking or analytics. Your location is used only to calculate prayer times and the Qibla, and it never reaches us.

OPEN SOURCE
I develop Namaz Akışı with the intention of sadaqah jariyah. The app is free, and its source code is open to everyone under the GNU GPLv3 license:
https://github.com/furkanisikay/namazakisi
whatsNew:
- The app is now available in 78 languages; choose yours in Settings. Languages such as Arabic, Urdu and Persian are shown from right to left.
- Accurate prayer times anywhere in the world: a calculation method for your country, and cities worldwide.
- Verse of the day: a new verse with its translation every day, in a Home Screen and Lock Screen widget.
- Choose the reminder sound from the app's sounds or add your own sound file.
- Security and stability improvements.
